title: 安全多方計算系統
summary: 以秘密分享、協議威脅模型與通訊成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect secret sharing, protocol threat models and communication with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 參與與威脅
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「參與與威脅」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop parties and threats through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 參與方角色：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「參與方角色」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for party roles.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「參與方角色」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for party roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：參與方越多就不需威脅模型。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More parties remove the need for threat models. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「參與方角色」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for party roles; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。
knowledge.textEn: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具模環 Z₁₇ 將秘密 s=9 分享為 4、7、15，因為 (4+7+15) mod17=9。每個分享若按正確隨機協議產生可隱藏原值；此固定例子不構成安全實作。加上公開值 3 後可只改一個分享為 7，和變為 12。
knowledge.textEn: Toy shares 4,7,15 in Z17 sum to secret 9. Secure hiding requires a correct randomized protocol; these fixed numbers are not a secure implementation. Adding public 3 to one share changes the reconstructed sum to 12.

quiz.question: 審查「參與方角色」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for party roles?
options: MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。
參與方越多就不需威脅模型。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「參與方角色」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion.
More parties remove the need for threat models.
One matching output proves party roles for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。 對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。 因此「參與方越多就不需威脅模型。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion. Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. The alternative "More parties remove the need for threat models." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 參與方角色：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「參與方角色」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for party roles.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。」；將結果與「MPC 保證依不串通或容忍串通的假設而定。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Compare results against: MPC guarantees depend on noncollusion or tolerated collusion. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：參與方越多就不需威脅模型。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More parties remove the need for threat models. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「參與方角色」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「參與方越多就不需威脅模型。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for party roles; explain why this claim fails: More parties remove the need for threat models.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for party roles?
options: 參與方越多就不需威脅模型。
對三方玩具計算標示哪組被假設誠實。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for honest and malicious behavior. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Semi-honest and malicious models allow different deviations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Distinguish analyzing compliant transcripts from forged messages. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 列出遵守協議但分析記錄與偽造訊息差異。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：半誠實安全自動等於惡意安全。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「誠實與惡意」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「列出遵守協議但分析記錄與偽造訊息差異。」如何辨別它們。

steps.title: 隨機性要求：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「隨機性要求」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for randomness requirements.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「隨機性要求」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分享隱私依賴足夠隨機且不重複的隨機量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for randomness requirements. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Share privacy needs adequate, unreused randomness. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：固定教學分享可直接用於保密生產資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Fixed teaching shares securely protect production data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「隨機性要求」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for randomness requirements; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
